  • Only localizing title and description — screenshot overlays still say "Works with Stage Manager" on every iPad frame
  • Machine-translating Stage Manager literally — awkward strings instead of idiomatic 台前调度 phrasing Chinese iPad buyers recognize from system UI
  • Conflating with Mac Catalyst marketing — Designed for iPad badges localized but Stage Manager multitasking copy still English; or the reverse
  • Ignoring window-resize caption lines — English "Resize windows in Stage Manager" on screenshots for a feature you ship but never market in Chinese
  • Assuming Stage Manager support in binary = localized storefront — in-app windowing does not auto-fill Connect overlay fields
  • English text burned into PNG exports — Connect caption fields are Chinese but the image file still embeds English Stage Manager headlines (a design fix, not a metadata paste)
  • Expecting AppLocale to configure iPadOS entitlements — multitasking entitlements, scene support, and window-resize code are outside listing rewrite

What good zh-Hans Stage Manager listing copy looks like

Stage Manager–centric listings name the multitasking workflow in plain zh-Hans — not a word-for-word mirror of English brochure lines:

  • Subtitle — one clause on resizable windows or app-group multitasking; room for 台前调度-adjacent search terms within 30 characters
  • Keywords — mix category terms (笔记, 设计, 效率) with multitasking intent (台前调度, 多任务, 窗口); avoid English-only "Stage Manager" stuffing
  • Description — lead with the Stage Manager workflow; mention resize and app-group support only when your app actually ships those capabilities
  • Screenshot overlays — short lines naming what the frame shows: 支持台前调度, 多任务窗口, 自由调整窗口大小 — not "Resize windows in Stage Manager" pasted through Google Translate
  • Voice match — same 你/您 and punctuation habits as your other zh-Hans fields

zh-Hans Stage Manager captions can differ idiomatically from en-US overlays when the on-screen feature is the same — avoid mirroring comma-heavy English marketing onto iPad art.
